verified.country: docs: https://docs.tavily.com/documentation/api-reference/endpoint/search (166 names; a boost, topic general only; others refused before the call)
verified.locale: docs: https://docs.tavily.com/documentation/api-reference/endpoint/search (language with filter_by_language, so a filter, not a boost)
verified.recency: docs: https://docs.tavily.com/documentation/api-reference/endpoint/search (time_range by publish or last updated date; filter_by_published_date drops undated pages)

include_domains_mode.note: restrict | prefer. Setting it without include_domains returns a 400.

topic.note: general (default) | news | finance. country is refused with any topic but general, which Tavily requires.

start_date.note: YYYY-MM-DD. How it combines with time_range, which recency sends, is not documented.

include_published_date.note: Boolean; turned on by filter_by_published_date, which recency sends.

chunks_per_source.note: 1-3: the most chunks (about 500 characters each on basic and fast, 800 on advanced) per result, documented for basic, fast and advanced search. Not in the depth table yet: lite (basic) returns up to three chunks, and one chunk would bring it near the shared ~500-character lite; due a live re-measure.

include_answer.note: true | false | basic | advanced; the answer lands in SearchResponse.answer.

safe_search.note: Boolean. Not supported with the fast or ultra-fast search depths.

max_age_hours.note: -1 to 720: the oldest cached content Tavily may return.
